extension.title: Settings
extension.launch: Allow the browser to open this app (securevault://)
extension.hint: Load the Firefox add-on, then paste this port and token into its options to pair. Credentials are only served on 127.0.0.1:{port} while the vault is unlocked.
extension.launch_hint: Lets the extension launch or focus this app when you ask it to generate or save a password. Registers a securevault:// link for your user only.
extension.tamper: Lock instantly if a debugger attaches
extension.tamper_hint: Anti-tampering: instantly locks the vault if a debugger attaches to the app. Off by default; it may cause antivirus false positives.

backup.title: Vault backup
backup.restore_confirm:
Replace your vault with the backup from {when}?

The vault as it is now is backed up first, and you will be asked to log in again.
backup.failed: Could not write a backup to that folder.
backup.hint: A copy is saved every time you add or change an account. Backups are encrypted with your master password, and read-only so they are not deleted by accident. The newest 20 are kept, plus one per day for the last 60 days. Pick a OneDrive folder to keep copies off this computer.

phone.title: Send to iPhone
phone.intro: On the iPhone, open Secure Vault and tap “Receive from PC”. Then pick the iPhone here and type the code it shows.
phone.none_found: No iPhone found. Keep the Receive screen open on the phone, or type the address it shows below.
phone.address: Or type the address the iPhone shows
phone.sent: Sent to {device}. Confirm on the iPhone to start using it.
phone.need_target: Pick an iPhone or type its address.
phone.need_code: Type the 6-digit code shown on the iPhone.
phone.err_novault: There is no saved vault to send yet.
phone.err_badcode: The iPhone rejected the code. Check it and try again.
phone.err_toolarge: The vault is too large to send.
phone.err_notvault: The iPhone didn't accept the file as a vault.
phone.err_busy: The iPhone already received a vault. Start again on the phone.
phone.err_unreachable: Couldn't reach the iPhone at {host}. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi and the Receive screen is open.
phone.err_noreply: The iPhone didn't answer. Try again.
phone.hint: The vault is sent exactly as it is stored here, encrypted with your master password. The iPhone asks before replacing anything and keeps its current vault as a backup.

extension.title: Impostazioni

extension.launch_hint: Permette all'estensione di avviare o portare in primo piano questa app quando chiedi di generare o salvare una password. Registra un collegamento securevault:// solo per il tuo utente.
extension.tamper: Blocca subito se un debugger si collega
extension.tamper_hint: Anti-manomissione: blocca subito il vault se un debugger si collega all'app. Disattivato per impostazione predefinita; può causare falsi positivi negli antivirus.

backup.title: Backup della cassaforte
backup.restore_confirm:
Sostituire il vault con il backup del {when}?

Il vault attuale viene salvato prima, e ti verrà chiesto di accedere di nuovo.
backup.failed: Impossibile scrivere un backup in quella cartella.
backup.hint: Una copia viene salvata ogni volta che aggiungi o modifichi un account. I backup sono cifrati con la tua password maestra e in sola lettura, per non eliminarli per sbaglio. Vengono conservati i 20 più recenti, più uno al giorno per gli ultimi 60 giorni. Scegli una cartella OneDrive per tenere le copie fuori da questo computer.

extension.launch: Autoriser le navigateur à ouvrir cette app (securevault://)

extension.tamper_hint: Anti-altération : verrouille immédiatement le coffre si un débogueur s'attache à l'application. Désactivé par défaut ; peut provoquer des faux positifs antivirus.

backup.title: Sauvegarde du coffre
backup.restore_confirm:

Les 20 plus récentes sont conservées, plus une par jour pour les 60 derniers jours. Choisissez un dossier OneDrive pour garder des copies hors de cet ordinateur.

extension.title: Indstillinger
extension.launch: Tillad browseren at åbne denne app (securevault://)
extension.hint: Indlæs Firefox-tilføjelsen, og indsæt derefter denne port og token i dens indstillinger for at parre. Adgangskoder leveres kun på 127.0.0.1:{port}, når boksen er låst op.
extension.launch_hint: Lader udvidelsen starte eller bringe denne app i forgrunden, når du beder om at generere eller gemme en adgangskode. Registrerer et securevault://-link kun for din bruger.
extension.tamper: Lås straks hvis en debugger tilknyttes
extension.tamper_hint: Anti-manipulation: låser straks boksen, hvis en debugger tilknyttes appen. Slået fra som standard; kan udløse falske antivirus-alarmer.

backup.title: Sikkerhedskopi
backup.restore_confirm:
Erstat din boks med backuppen fra {when}?

Boksen, som den er nu, sikkerhedskopieres først, og du bliver bedt om at logge ind igen.
backup.failed: Kunne ikke skrive en backup til den mappe.
backup.hint: Der gemmes en kopi, hver gang du tilføjer eller ændrer en konto. Backups er krypteret med din hovedadgangskode og skrivebeskyttede, så de ikke slettes ved et uheld. De 20 nyeste beholdes, plus én om dagen de sidste 60 dage. Vælg en OneDrive-mappe for at holde kopier væk fra denne computer.

phone.need_target: Vælg en iPhone, eller indtast dens adresse.

phone.err_novault: Der er endnu ingen gemt boks at sende.

phone.err_toolarge: Boksen er for stor til at blive sendt.
